title: Gluing the standard generators of a projective-line twist
statement: Let k be a field and d∈ℤ. On P¹_k with its standard cover [def-sc-p1-standard], there exists an O-module L and sections g₀ and g₁ which trivialize L on every subopen of U₀ and U₁ respectively and satisfy g₀|U₀₁=(x₀/x₁)^d g₁|U₀₁; equivalently there exists TwistData of degree d on L. This statement asserts no invertibility conclusion and no uniqueness or comparison with another module.

source.place: Proof, construction of the local free modules, the transition map, its cocycle, and the glued module

proof.text: Take L to be the explicitly constructed integral-model module ProjectiveSpace.twist (ULift (Fin 2)) (Spec k) d. The existing nonempty_twistData_projectiveSpace theorem supplies TwistData on this very module, with both free chart generators and the prescribed transition coefficient, for every integer d. Introduce this module as the existential witness; no gluing theorem or choice of an unspecified object is required.

proof_origin.place: Tags 01MN and 01M7, Section 01MM; reuse the proved integral-model TwistData construction and introduce its module as the existence witness.

mathlib_searches.query: Existence of a sheaf of modules on the projective line with local bases related by a unit on the overlap
A sheaf of modules with a basis section on each open of a cover is locally free of rank one and maps preserving the generators are unique
mathlib_searches.results: SheafOfModules.freeSection, SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.π, SheafOfModules.LocalGeneratorsData; none constructs a twist with the prescribed transition unit.
SheafOfModules.unitHomEquiv and its naturality lemmas construct morphisms from the unit, not the glued twist.

Existing TwistData definition in TransitionUnits; ProjShiftedFreeTwist asserts existence only as part of a stronger theorem and imports the present item, so cannot be used without a cycle. No separate construction theorem found.

from.place: Proof, first three sentences: local free modules, transition map, cocycle identities, and gluing the module and its trivializations

lean.statement:
theorem exists_twistData (k : Type u) [Field k] (d : ℤ) :
    ∃ L : (ProjectiveLine (Spec (.of k))).Modules,
      Nonempty (TwistData (Spec (.of k)) d L)
